name: 98201 · Everett, WA
findings: ZIP 98201 (Everett) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 82 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98201 (Everett) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98201 (Everett) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 63 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
